part1.evidence_class: BENCHMARK re-analysis of B-02 raw/measured (240 trials); no new trials

best_arm_rules.spec_literal: lowest median T_oracle among arms whose validity gates held, no knob-verdict filter (K5EV in every class)
best_arm_rules.b02_keep_only: B-02 E2 rule (arms whose knobs are all DELETED (KEEP)): K5V fill/toggle, K5 modal

part1.component_rules: B-02 analyze_browser.trial_row/arm_block + B-01 decompose (unchanged); material = mean component >= 5% of mean T_runner or >= 50 ms
part1.untested_share_rule: B-02 rule: admission residual in V arms + unattributed + cold-first-snapshot excess where H_W is UNDECIDED, over mean T_runner; reported for K5V and K5EV in every class

part2.harness: run_b03.py: B-01 run_critpath step loop (K5 base knobs as in B-02) with three marked insertions (P warm-up, D delay, nc pre-snapshot); B-02 run_b02 knob plumbing; rc.one bookkeeping; scripted chooser
part2.environment: hostless v2 + cua-x11-session.sh (private Xvfb/openbox/picom, private dbus), CUA_SESSION_EXTRA_ENV='CUA_DRIVER_RS_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=0 DO_NOT_TRACK=1'; system Chrome via browser_prepare {allow_launch, isolated_new}

P.cold: fresh Driver + fresh browser per trial (B-02 default)
P.warm: same fresh Driver/browser, then one throwaway browser_navigate + semantic_v2 snapshot of a different document on the same owned fixture origin before task start (toggle: <i24 origin>/modal; fill: <fill origin>/state), then the task navigate

D.0: first observation sent as soon as the step-1 pre-observation oracle read returns (B-02 timing)
D.80: the harness sleeps 80 ms after navigate returns (after the step-1 pre-observation oracle read) before the first observation send

design.toggle: 2x2x2 P x D x K, n=20 per cell (160 trials); 20 rounds; within a round the 8 cells run in Williams row r mod 8 (williams(8)); rows 0-3 are used 3 times and rows 4-7 twice (20 is not a multiple of 8)
design.fill_positive_replication: 2x2 P x D under K5V, n=10 per cell (40 trials), in even rounds, Williams row (r/2) mod 4 of williams(4)
design.negative_control: toggle, K5V, P=cold, D=0, variant nc: one extra semantic_v2 snapshot of the task document right after the task navigate, so the task's snapshot1 is a re-snapshot of the same document with no navigation; n=20, one per round
design.round_layout: toggle cells 1-4, fill cells 1-2 (even rounds), nc, toggle cells 5-8, fill cells 3-4 (even rounds)
design.chunks: two quiet-timed EXCLUSIVE windows: rounds 0-9 and rounds 10-19 (each about 110 trials, well under 15 minutes); R2-10 has lock priority
design.shakedown: 7 SHARED-lock trials before the measured block, excluded from every number (kept in raw/)

part2.forced_path: dom_event clicks through the CDP engine (B-01 forced_path: tools, routes, input_route=dom_event, feedback off, 10 ms poll, settle 0 on fill) and the B-02 knob path from the Driver's own marks (V: every tools/call in T shows mcp.inner_validation_skipped; E: ep.bound_stored at bind and one ep.bound_hit per mutation in T)
part2.producer_attribution: Driver snap.* marks of snapshot1 and snapshot2: attach (snap.enter->snap.attached), DOM.getDocument (->snap.document), Page.getFrameTree (->snap.frame_tree), DOMSnapshot.captureSnapshot + Page.getLayoutMetrics (->snap.layout_cdp_done), Accessibility.getFullAXTree (snap.indexed->snap.ax_cdp_done), total (snap.enter->snap.serialized)
part2.oracle: independent target-owned server state (fixture JournalState / FixtureState), re-read every 2 ms by a harness thread (OraclePoller), plus the CLOCK_MONOTONIC server journal of every mutation

measures.cold_excess_ms: snapshot1 span - snapshot2 span (the warm same-document re-snapshot; B-02 definition, analyze_browser first_snapshot_excess_ms)
measures.T_oracle_ms: task_start (stamped immediately before the D wait; equal to the first observation send for D=0) -> first oracle-confirmed 2 ms read; includes the 80 ms wait for D=80
measures.bind_end_to_oracle_ms: bind return -> first oracle-confirmed read (secondary moved-work view)

part2.statistics: paired within round (each round holds every toggle cell once); median of round differences with B-01's seeded percentile bootstrap (10000 resamples, seed 20261002); one-sample medians use the same bootstrap over trials; ms accounting for the untested share uses means (additive), verdicts use medians and CIs

verdict_rules_per_K.per_process: PP = paired median of cold_excess(cold, D80) - cold_excess(warm, D80)
verdict_rules_per_K.per_document: PD = paired median of cold_excess(warm, D0) - cold_excess(warm, D80) (reported; the spec's definition)
verdict_rules_per_K.per_process_rule: if PP CI excludes 0 (lower bound > 0) and PP >= 0.5 * E: the PP part is per-process first-document work, verdict NOT DELETED (moved only: pre-warming moves it before task start), UNLESS warm-process T_oracle including the warm-up (warmup_ms + T_oracle(warm, D0)) is lower than T_oracle(cold, D0) with a paired CI excluding 0, in which case OWNER_DECISION (the product would need a warm pool). If PP's CI excludes 0 but PP < 0.5 * E, or PP's CI includes 0 while PP's mean is > 0, the PP part is UNDECIDED and counts as untested
verdict_rules_per_K.per_document_rule: evaluated at P=cold (the B-02 default path; primary) and reported at P=warm. dT = paired median of T_oracle(D80, incl. the wait) - T_oracle(D0). If dT >= -2 ms: the delay-removable part is IRREDUCIBLE (document readiness; the delay only moves the wait). If T_oracle(D0) - T_oracle(D80) has a CI excluding 0 (lower bound > 0) and its median > 2 ms: H_W DELETED candidate (snapshot after readiness), KEEP. Otherwise UNDECIDED (counts as untested)
verdict_rules_per_K.accounting_partition: mean cold_excess(cold, D0) = doc_cold [mean(cold D0 - cold D80), verdict = per_document_rule] + per_process [mean(cold D80 - warm D80), verdict = per_process_rule] + floor [mean cold_excess(warm, D80)]. floor counts as untested only if its one-sample CI excludes 0 and it is > 0; a negative part is reported and not counted
verdict_rules_per_K.toggle_untested_share: for K5V and K5EV: (admission residual after V + unattributed + every UNDECIDED part above) / mean T_runner of the (cold, D0) cell of this block. Also restated on B-02's E2 rows by replacing B-02's UNDECIDED cold excess with its untested fraction from this block

part2.positive_replication: fill under K5V: PP CI excludes 0 and PP >= 0.5 * E(fill) reproduces B-02 fill's 'moved only'. If it fails, the toggle per_process verdict is reported but counted UNDECIDED (the probe did not discriminate)

gates.validity: >= 95% valid per cell: toggle >= 19/20, fill 10/10, negative control >= 19/20 (B-02 trial_row validity: oracle exact match, exactly 1 completion mutation, runner verified, B-01 forced path, B-02 knob path, T defined)
gates.invariants: 0 stale dispatches (no action with effect refused/unverifiable or a browser_ref_stale code), 0 duplicate completion mutations, 0 unverified successes (runner verified while the oracle disagrees), 0 non-loopback connects from the runner
gates.negative_control: median cold_excess of the nc variant has a CI that includes 0
gates.failing_gate: a failed validity or invariant gate makes the affected verdicts UNDECIDED; every failure stays in the denominator and in raw/

part2.claim_boundary: binary 7e6c0609 only, jev-use toggle/fill, X11 Xvfb under hostless v2, scripted chooser. A component verdict transfers to R2-10's source by mechanism only; it is never added to R2-10 numbers

invariants: no new service; no Driver change; knobs env-gated and default off (unchanged from B-02); events are hints only; no authority from passive state; the oracle is the target-owned server state
